summary: Prepare a V's record on the host for one requester.

faults.when: The request isn't one of the accepted versions.

x-friction.gap: The host run for one character request is shared by every page that asks for it, while a page's newer request replaces only that page's older one for the same V.
x-friction.closes: Requests that name who they are for, shared by equal goals, superseded per requester and key.
